title: Don't copy the WaitGroup
hints: worker receives the WaitGroup by value, so it calls Done on its own copy. The original's counter never reaches zero.
A WaitGroup (like a Mutex) must not be copied after first use. go vet's copylocks check reports this: try go vet in your workspace.
func worker(id int, wg *sync.WaitGroup, out []int) — and call it as go worker(i, &wg, out)
